caption: The drawing consists of two main horizontal bands surrounded by a white border. The larger upper band features a repeating pattern of light brown, maple-like leaves filled with red vein details, set against a slightly textured off-white background. The leaves are evenly spaced and distributed, with their edges defined in a subtle contrasting outline. Below this is a narrower blue band that contains a series of alternating motifs: stylized light brown flower shapes with red centers and simple four-petal clover forms, both evenly spaced across the length of the band. There are thin lines separating the two bands, one with a small repeating dot pattern in red on a light background. The composition uses primarily muted tones of blue, brown, red, and off-white, and is presented on what appears to be a sheet of paper with visible tape marks at the corners.
title: Wallpaper
